sentences.text:
Jhari Thakur vs The State Of Jharkhand And Another on 21 July,
2023

Author: Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
Bench: Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi

In The High Court Of Jharkhand, Ranchi
 ----
W.P.(Cr.) No. 403 of 2023
----
1.Jhari Thakur
2.Lakhi Devi @ Budhani Devi @ Lalita Devi .... Petitioners
-- Versus --
The State of Jharkhand and Another .... Respondents

---- 
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
---
 For the Petitioners :- Mr. S.S.Choudhary, Advocate
 For the State :- A.P.P.
 ----
2/21.07.2023
The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioner no.1 is husband and the petitioner no.2 is mother in law of the respondent no.2.
He submits that the respondent no.2 is not willing to reside along with the family members of the petitioners and she is forcing the petitioner no.1 to reside separately.
He submits that there are general and omnibus allegations against the petitioners and the case has been registered under section 498A of the IPC as well as other sections of the IPC.
3. Issue notice upon the respondent no.2 by registered post with A/d as well as under ordinary process for which requisites etc must be filed within two weeks.
